title: Cheesecloths For Herbalism
intro: Cheesecloths are thin, woven fabric squares commonly used in herbalism and home apothecaries. They serve as a versatile tool for straining liquids, drying herbs, and preserving tinctures. In herbal practice, cheesecloths help filter out plant particles, ensuring cleaner extracts and infusions. Their simplicity and effectiveness make them an essential item in any herbalist's toolkit.
